$comment: Mutation arms cutting the types of package anyparse.check.common.literals. Format and rules: docs/testing.md, Declared arms.

arms.name: M-STRING-LITERAL-DUP-REASON-MUTE
arms.note: the rule declares `NoAutofix` with an empty sentence, so `--fix` reports it as report-only without saying that `apq extract-constant` does the hoist

arms.name: M-STRING-LITERAL-DUP-TABLE-ARITY
arms.find: return node.kind == t.arrayLiteralKind && node.children.foreach(kid -> isDataEntry(kid, source, t));
arms.replace:
return node.kind == t.arrayLiteralKind && node.children.length >= 3
			&& node.children.foreach(kid -> isDataEntry(kid, source, t));
arms.note: the arity floor is back, so a one- or two-name vocabulary array (`arrayTypeNames: ['Array']`) is read as logic again and its entries count toward the repetition

arms.name: M-STRING-LITERAL-DUP-TABLE-ANY
arms.note: homogeneity is dropped and every collection literal is a table, so an expression list mixing identifiers with literals exempts its literals

arms.name: M-STRING-LITERAL-DUP-MAP-ENTRY-BLIND
arms.note: a map ENTRY is no longer a data entry, so a `kind => type` table has no bare-literal child and every key of it counts as a repetition again

arms.name: M-STRING-LITERAL-DUP-STRING-ONLY-ENTRIES
arms.note: only a string literal is a data entry, so a map storing numbers (`['Map' => 1, 'Array' => 0]`) stops being a table and its keys count again

arms.name: M-TOSTRING-RETURN-TRUSTED
arms.note: an instance call's declared return is trusted by name under null safety, so a method returning a typedef of `Null<…>` loses its `.toString()`

arms.name: M-TOSTRING-FACTS-CLASS
arms.note: a receiver the resolution scope does not declare keeps its `.toString()` whatever the compiler's facts say

arms.name: M-TOSTRING-FACTS-EXTERN
arms.note: an extern class's `.toString()` is dropped, though the string coercion may call the native one

arms.name: M-FACTS-ALIKE-TOSTRING
arms.note: a class extern in one configuration and not in another is proven by the first one's record

arms.name: M-TOSTRING-CALL-BY-NAME
replace: final owners: Null<Array<ResolvedType>> = ctx.index.refs.resolvedDeclsNamed(TypeResolver.identTypeName(owner, ctx.root, seams.shape, ctx.declaredTypes) ?? '');
arms.note: a call receiver is typed by its owner's SIMPLE name, so `far.Holder.get()` reads as the same-package `Holder.get()`

arms.name: M-TOSTRING-CALL-CUT
arms.note: no call receiver is ever typed

arms.name: M-TOSTRING-IDENT-CUT
arms.note: an identifier or construction receiver's type is never bound

arms.name: M-TOSTRING-STRING-BINDING
arms.note: an identifier typed `String` counts as the built-in even where an import binds `String` to another type

arms.name: M-MAGIC-CALLARG-BLIND
arms.note: a direct argument of a call ignoreCallArguments names is flagged as a magic number

arms.name: M-MAGIC-CALLARG-SUFFIX-LOOSE
arms.note: an ignoreCallArguments entry matches any callee sharing its last segment, so Lang.t exempts a bare t()

arms.name: M-MAGIC-CALLARG-NEG-BLIND
arms.note: a negation does not hand the argument context to its literal, so f(-18) is flagged while f(18) is exempt

arms.name: M-MAGIC-CALLARG-NEW-BLIND
arms.note: a constructor never matches an ignoreCallArguments entry, so `ShapeDescriptor.new` exempts nothing

arms.name: M-MAGIC-CALLARG-NESTED-NEW
arms.note: a value object built in place as a listed argument (`new ShapeDescriptor(id, new Point(-18, -83))`) no longer carries the callee's context, so its literals are flagged

arms.name: M-MAGIC-TABLE-SWITCH-BLIND
arms.note: no switch is a lookup table, so `case 0x410300: 0xC0;` is flagged under literalTables

arms.name: M-MAGIC-TABLE-SWITCH-ARM-LOOSE
arms.find: for (i in 0...last) if (!isTablePattern(arm.children[i], source, t)) return false;
arms.note: an arm is judged by its value alone, so a guarded or capturing switch reads as a table and its literals are exempt

arms.name: M-MAGIC-TABLE-COLLECTION-BLIND
arms.note: no named collection of literals is a table, so `final widths = [30, 45]` is flagged under literalTables

arms.name: M-MAGIC-TABLE-COLLECTION-UNNAMED
arms.note: every all-literal collection is a table, so an inline `draw([3, 4])` is exempt though nothing names it

arms.name: M-MAGIC-TABLES-DEFAULT-ON
arms.note: literalTables is on when no project sets it, so every existing configuration silently loses its switch-table findings

arms.name: M-LITERAL-TABLE-NEG-ENTRY-BLIND
arms.note: a negative number is no data entry, so a table holding -1 is logic again (Base64 decode table, a map of negative values)

arms.name: M-FOLD-FIX-REPORT-INDEX
arms.find: OperatorSelection.of(plugin, [{ file: file, source: source }], index)
arms.note: the fold's fix judges a construct the run left report-only against its own file's overloads alone, and merges past a sibling module's

arms.name: M-FOLD-STATEMENT-UNPROVEN
arms.find: return statementScope != null && rendersAlone(statementScope, memberScope) ? statementScope : memberScope;
arms.note: a body statement stands in for its member without the evidence that the member renders it as it renders alone, and a function literal's body the source under-indents is measured a tab narrow
